definitions.explanation: Accepting something unpleasant or difficult without resistance. Implies willingly or resignedly enduring hardship, punishment, or unfavorable circumstances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{甘受|かんじゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{甘受|かんじゅ}し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。

⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{不便|ふべん}→不便：01501_fuben⟧さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{甘受|かんじゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧。
examples.english: Since this is the result of my own choice, I have no choice but to accept this inconvenience.

notes:
{甘受|かんじゅ} means accepting something unpleasant without resistance. It implies resignation or willingness to endure hardship.

WRITING:
The character {甘|かん} here means "willingly" or "contentedly," not its more common meaning of "sweet."

COMMON OBJECTS (always negative):
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{甘受|かんじゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to accept criticism
- ⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{甘受|かんじゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to accept punishment
- ⟦{不利益|ふりえき}→不利益：11481_furieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{甘受|かんじゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to accept disadvantage
- ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{甘受|かんじゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to accept consequences

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れる→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧: to accept (neutral; broader use)
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}する→我慢する：25343_gamansuru⟧: to endure, put up with (focuses on the suffering)
- ⟦{諦|あきら}める→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧: to give up, resign oneself (focuses on abandoning hope)

REGISTER:
Formal and literary. Common in written Japanese, legal contexts, and serious discussion. Rarely used in casual conversation.
